description: This file is a test script for Git's multi-pack index functionality, including setup, pack creation, corruption tests, validation, and various operations related to multi-pack index management.

methods.name: midx_read_expect
methods.description: Checks the contents of a multi-pack index against expected values by reading and comparing.

methods.name: generate_objects
methods.description: Generates random objects for testing by creating different types of data blobs and updating the git index.

methods.name: commit_and_list_objects
methods.description: Creates a commit and lists objects, assisting in pack creation tests.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk
methods.description: Corrupts a specific chunk in the multi-pack index to test error handling.

methods.name: corrupt_midx_and_verify
methods.description: Corrupts the midx file at a specified position and verifies error detection.

methods.name: corrupt_data
methods.description: Utility to corrupt arbitrary data in a file at a given position.

methods.name: test_midx_is_retained
methods.description: Verifies that an existing multi-pack index remains unchanged after an operation.

methods.name: test_midx_is_rewritten
methods.description: Verifies that a multi-pack index is rewritten after an operation.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Used throughout to confirm commands fail as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to pass successfully.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks expected exit codes from commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
